strategies.name: DYNAMIC_EDGE_GEO_CURRENCY_LOCALIZATION
strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Detects country at edge socket; switches pricing from USD to local currency (INR, EUR, GBP) without redirecting URL, preserving canonical equity.

strategies.name: FCrDNS_BOT_SPOOFING_INTERSTITIAL_GATE

wire_or_code_signature.mechanism: Double PTR-to-A Lookup + Akamai PoW fallback

strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Checks incoming crawler IP against Googlebot/Bingbot reverse DNS. Verified bots get precomputed static HTML; untrusted bots are sent to Proof-of-Work traps.

strategies.name: HTTP3_HIGH_CONCURRENCY_CATALOG_PIPELINING
strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Allows Googlebot to multiplex 50+ SKU image and product requests over a single UDP socket without connection re-negotiation overhead.

strategies.name: JA4_TLS_FINGERPRINT_COMPLIANCE_HARMONIZATION
strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Harmonizes cipher suite order with modern Chrome browser handshakes, preventing false bot-flagging by enterprise WAFs.

strategies.name: SURROGATE_KEY_FLASH_SALE_INVENTORY_PURGING
strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Instantly purges edge cache when an item goes out of stock or price drops; keeps Google Shopping cache in perfect sync with real-time database.

strategies.name: RFC9111_ETAG_REVALIDATION_CATALOG_DELTA
strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Responds with 304 Not Modified (0 payload bytes) for unchanged catalog items, saving 80% of crawler bandwidth.

strategies.name: ECOMMERCE_CART_CHECKOUT_CRAWL_TRAP_DISALLOW
strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Hard-blocks non-indexable transactional flows, ensuring 100% of crawler bandwidth indexes SKU product landing pages.

strategies.name: FACETED_FILTER_CANONICAL_INDEX_COLLAPSING
strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Collapses 500+ color, size, and sorting parameters (?color=blue&size=XL) into the primary canonical parent SKU URL, concentrating PageRank equity.

strategies.name: RFC9116_MERCHANT_SECURITY_AND_DISCLOSURE
strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Supplies automated security disclosure policies, satisfying enterprise merchant trustworthiness raters in Google E-E-A-T.

strategies.name: PAYMENT_GATEWAY_PCI_DSS_TOKEN_SHIELD
strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Isolates checkout frames under strict CSP, maintaining PCI compliance and eliminating merchant security demotions.

strategies.name: ADAPTIVE_SRCSET_AVIF_RENDER_OPTIMIZATION
strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Delivers exact screen-resolution AVIF/WebP assets via <picture> and srcset, locking mobile Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) under 1.2s on 4G networks.

strategies.name: USER_QUERY_QA_ACCORDION_BERT_SPAN_WINDOW

wire_or_code_signature.envelope: 42-55 word affirmative answers to buyer questions

strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Pairs buyer questions ('Does this fit model X?') with 40-word affirmative answers, capturing long-tail Google 'People Also Ask' accordions.

strategies.name: SCHEMA_PRODUCTGROUP_AND_HASVARIANT_DAG_MATRIX
strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Structures entire matrix of sizes, colors, and SKU variations inside a single parent ProductGroup DAG. Google Shopping indexes every variant instantly without duplicate penalties.

strategies.name: STRUCTURED_ITEMLIST_CATEGORY_CAROUSEL_INGRESS
strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Declares collection pages as structured ItemLists, enabling Google to index multi-product carousel cards directly on Category PLP searches.

strategies.name: MULTI_CURRENCY_INTERNATIONAL_HREFLANG_GRID
strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Maps dedicated regional country stores (e.g. store.com/en-us vs store.com/en-in), avoiding Google duplicate penalties and locking top local rankings.

strategies.name: PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION_TABLE_FLOAT_ARRAY
strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Formats physical dimensions, battery capacity, wattage, and material into rigid HTML tables. AI shopping engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity) cite table cells for comparative queries.

strategies.name: AKAMAI_JA4_POW_CHALLENGE_DECOUPLING

wire_or_code_signature.mechanism: JA4 Cipher Order + WebAssembly Client Puzzle (challenge.js)

strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Amazon isolates non-browser TLS handshakes at Layer 4/7 via Akamai JA4 hashing. Unmatched cipher suites are trapped in a Wasm computational puzzle before origin HTML renders. Bypassed via headless browser context injection using matched client ciphers and residential proxy routing.

strategies.name: AMAZON_DYNAMIC_ASIN_AVAILABILITY_GRAPH
strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Resolves real-time merchant buybox algorithmic rankings, delivery windows, and stock state into microdata. Allows AI shopping assistants (e.g. Rufus, Perplexity Buy) to extract authoritative purchase URLs with live price precision.

strategies.name: AMAZON_IMAGE_BLOCK_HIRES_ZOOM_LATTICE
strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Embeds raw JSON dictionaries of multi-resolution image URLs directly inside img tag data attributes. Vision LLMs (GPT-4o, Gemini Pro Vision) parse the JSON lattice to pull full 1500x1500px uncompressed product assets for visual feature reasoning.

strategies.name: CLOUDFLARE_TURNSTILE_POW_DECAY_SESSION_VAULT
strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Cloudflare enforces dynamic canvas and mathematical attestation challenges. Once solved, the edge issues a signed 'cf_clearance' cookie with decaying computational difficulty. Reusing this cookie across matched TLS fingerprints maintains unbroken high-throughput crawling.

strategies.name: POST_CHALLENGE_REACT_SERVER_COMPONENT_WIRE_HARVESTING
strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Harvests raw typed React Server Component (RSC) flight data streams post-Cloudflare clearance. Bypasses client-side DOM rendering entirely, giving LLMs direct access to normalized backend relational state trees with zero DOM parsing overhead.

strategies.name: UNIVERSAL_COMMERCE_PROTOCOL_MACHINE_LINKING
strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Cloudflare-fronted enterprise commerce platforms (e.g. Shopify D2C) advertise machine-readable commerce endpoints via HTTP Link headers, allowing purchasing agents to bypass frontend HTML and execute structured basket and checkout RPCs directly.

strategies.name: EDGE_SERVER_TIMING_FRESHNESS_CALCULUS
strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Examines edge micro-diagnostics in Server-Timing headers to determine exact database query latency and cache state (HIT/DYNAMIC). Enables autonomous indexers to predict origin freshness and dynamically adapt crawl frequency without polling full documents.

strategies.name: KEVLAR_JWT_EDGE_STATE_CRYPTO_TOKEN
strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Flipkart issues a stateless HMAC-SHA256 JWT cookie ('at') issued by 'kevlar' on the initial edge TCP handshake. Encodes device ID, geographic zone (z=CH/HYD), and tenant ID (mapi) directly into client state. Bypasses centralized DB lookups for session authorization, cutting origin latency $<15ms$ for crawlers.

strategies.name: CLIENT_HINT_SEC_CH_UA_ENTROPY_NEGOTIATION

wire_or_code_signature.header: Accept-CH: Sec-CH-UA, Sec-CH-UA-Arch, Sec-CH-UA-Full-Version, Sec-CH-UA-Model, Sec-CH-UA-Platform

strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Demands fine-grained device architecture, model, and platform version via W3C Client Hints instead of parsing legacy User-Agent strings. Allows Flipkart's edge to dynamically branch into mobile vs desktop server-rendered layouts without UA regex penalties.

strategies.name: MULTI_WIDGET_STATE_JSON_HYDRATION_MONOLITH
strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Emits an 820KB monolithic typed JSON state tree inside `<script>` tags rather than rendering complete DOM nodes. LLM extraction spiders parse `multiWidgetState.pageDataResponse` directly, bypassing human DOM layout parsing and eliminating 100% of headless browser rendering overhead.

strategies.name: FEATURE_LEVEL_PARAMETRIC_RATING_VECTOR_LATTICE
strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Extracts granular parametric sub-ratings (Camera, Battery, Display, Build Quality, Value for Money) into normalized numerical float vectors. Enables AI shopping comparison engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search) to answer dimensional queries ('Which phone has the highest battery rating under 70k?') with definitive numerical citations.

strategies.name: DUAL_ENGINE_SEARCH_ITEMLIST_DAG_INJECTION

wire_or_code_signature.item_element: ListItem with position, name, url, image

strategies.mechanics_and_impact: Injects clean JSON-LD ItemList arrays on search results and collection pages. Enables Google to assemble interactive SERP product carousels while simultaneously allowing AI crawlers to discover canonical PDP slugs with position ranking signals.
